connector.name: Cortex by tootie.tv
connector.registryDescription: Syslog receiver and MCP server for homelab log intelligence.
connector.summary: Hosted at cortex.tootie.tv over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image cortex:v3.9.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace tv.tootie. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
